name: Shamlaji Temple
summary: Shamlaji — ancient Vishnu temple on the Gujarat–Rajasthan pilgrimage corridor.
famousFor: Tribal–Vaishnava fair · North Gujarat pilgrimage search
mythology: Shamlaji Temple at Shamlaji, Aravalli, Gujarat is dedicated to Lord Vishnu (Shamlaji / Gadadhar), known especially for Tribal–Vaishnava fair · North Gujarat pilgrimage search. Pilgrimage tradition places the shrine within India’s tirtha network — a seat where vows, gratitude, and family kuladevi / ishta devotion gather. Local sthala-purana and priestly teaching elaborate how Lord Vishnu (Shamlaji / Gadadhar) blesses those who arrive with sincere intent; festival days intensify these beliefs through special alankara and community worship where practised.

whatToCarry: Sun cap and light cotton for hot plains. Modest clothes, ID proof, water, and offline maps.
climate: Hot and dry inland; humid on the coast; monsoon mid-year.
